mapper.sql: report_id, report_date, title, summary, content, report_status, generation_source, model_name, prompt_version, valid_from, valid_until, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_market_report ( report_date, title, summary, content, report_status, generation_source, model_name, prompt_version, valid_from, valid_until ) VALUES ( #{reportDate}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{reportStatus}, #{generationSource}, #{modelName}, #{promptVersion}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE report_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(report_id), title = VALUES(title), summary = VALUES(summary), content = VALUES(content), report_status = VALUES(report_status), generation_source = VALUES(generation_source), model_name = VALUES(model_name), prompt_version = VALUES(prompt_version), valid_from = VALUES(valid_from), valid_until = VALUES(valid_until)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM daily_market_report ORDER BY report_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM daily_market_report WHERE report_date = #{reportDate} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_market_report SET title = '오늘의 AI 시장 리포트', summary = 'Gemini가 인용 가능한 사실 기반 리포트를 준비 중입니다.', content = '오늘의 시장 리포트 생성이 진행 중입니다. 인용 가능한 사실 기반 본문이 준비되기 전까지 내용을 제공하지 않습니다.', report_status = 'PARTIAL', generation_source = 'FALLBACK', model_name = 'gemini-3.6-flash', prompt_version = 'in-progress' WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND COALESCE(generation_source, 'FALLBACK') <> 'GEMINI' AND COALESCE(prompt_version, '') <> 'in-progress'
